failure.symptom: Trajectory screenshot is absent from image list
failure.root_cause: MolmoWeb trajectory Parquet rows may store image bytes in images and the corresponding filenames in the parallel image_paths column. The materializer read only images and therefore could not name byte-only image entries.
failure.detection: The zero-missing merge gate rejected the first completed shard summaries before any corpus merge, model inference, or training.

correction.change: Read image_paths when present and resolve trajectory screenshots by explicit path, basename, or deterministic positional fallback.
